C-RU-GOVERNING.Summary: Translate the Portfolio Management Model, Solution Lifecycle Model and AI Policy into formal Russian as the next corpus translation batch, and regenerate their corpus-grounded site projections.

Goals.Goal: Establish consistent Russian financial, business and IT terminology without changing definitions, decision rights or normative force.
Translate all three remaining governing documents completely, retain identities and clause structure, review against the comparison files, and render the site from the Russian corpus.

Constraints.Constraint: The owner's "proceed" approves the preceding recommendation to continue with Portfolio Management Model, Solution Lifecycle Model and AI Policy. The corpus is the source of truth; no language has automatic precedence.
Preserve unrelated work and existing decisions. Adapt language-specific spelling and style conventions appropriately for Russian without changing business rules.
Correct directly exposed language-rendering issues needed for real Russian content; keep page identity stable.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Declare the remaining corpus translated or invent policy, decisions, approvals or external validation.
Publish new translations to the live service in this batch; prepare the sources and generated site for review.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: All three Russian governing documents cover every source clause and table row with consistent professional terminology and actual source-revision metadata.

Russian portfolio, lifecycle and AI policy pages, diagrams and their corpus-derived sections show the translated titles and bodies, correctly resolving references, metadata and search; untranslated pages remain honestly identified.
Existing source checks, renderer tests, scaffolding checks and deterministic build pass. Corpus status documentation reflects nine completed governing-document translations.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Clause-by-clause translation review, parallel table coverage, real generated Russian pages and search, unchanged source-language document meaning.
